identificationModule.briefTitle: Study of Efficacy and Safety of LEE011 in Postmenopausal Women With Advanced Breast Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study of LEE011 in Combination With Letrozole for the Treatment of Postmenopausal Women With Hormone Receptor Positive, HER2 Negative, Advanced Breast Cancer Who Received no Prior Therapy for Advanced Disease

armGroups.label: Ribociclib+ letrozole
armGroups.description: Ribociclib 600 mg daily oral (3 weeks on/ 1 week off) in combination with letrozole 2.5 mg daily oral

armGroups.label: Placebo + letrozole
armGroups.description:
Placebo daily oral (3 weeks on/ 1 week off) in combination with letrozole 2.5 mg daily oral.

Participants were unblinded once the final OS analysis was completed and after the implementation of protocol amendment 10 (30-Apr-21) and were given the option to crossover to treatment with ribociclib + letrozole

interventions.name: Ribociclib
interventions.description: Ribociclib (600 mg, in three 200 mg hard gelatin capsules or tablets) was administered orally once daily on Days 1-21 of each 28-day cycle.

interventions.name: Letrozole
interventions.description: Letrozole (2.5 mg, tablets) was administered orally once daily on a continuous daily schedule (days 1-28 of each 28-day cycle)

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: Placebo (hard gelatin capsules or tablets) was administered orally once daily on Days 1-21 of each 28-day cycle.
